These relaxed, tapered trousers feature a top-secret back elastic that’s hidden between two butt-boosting darts. The waist will lay flat with no shirring and no gaping. There’s a functional button fly and our signature top-entry pockets. Because of the cropped inseam, these pants will look full-length (and super cute) on petites.

title: Odeon Stretch Cotton Chambray Shirtdress - Woodstock Indigo
sourceText: Everyone’s favorite luxe shirtdress now comes in stretch cotton chambray. Lightweight and breathable, the silhouette is streamlined and simple with only the most considered details—a point collar, a full button placket, functional sleeve cuffs, and slits at the curved hem. And, while oversized, the silhouette is clean and polished. But we’ve added some nice distressing details along the edges. We love this as a dress, of course, but also as an open duster jacket!

title: Kidjo Tailored Wool Blend Jacket - Deep Red
sourceText: Meet your perfect city coat. Tailored and chic, it’s made from our luxe wool blend. Key details include the single button closure, patch pockets at the hips, and a subtle peplum-style hem. We love wearing this style with a dressier outfit but it also looks cute with jeans.

title: Marlo Cocoon Coat - Indigo Plaid
sourceText: Vintage-inspired and timeless, the Marlo Coat is a true hero piece. Made from a soft and warm wool blend or custom herringbone tweed, it’s tailored to have a structured cocoon silhouette that feels cozy and not restrictive. It’s a sophisticated take on the everyday wool coat… because everyone needs a small dose of couture in their wardrobe. Details include the funnel neck, dropped shoulders, off-center buttons, and hip pockets. Coat is fully lined.

title: Maine Stretch Flannel Shirtdress - Kent Plaid
sourceText: This is the fall staple. Comfy, fuzzy stretch flannel will keep you cozy through the chilliest days. It’s the dress version of your favorite Maine Stretch Flannel Shirt. We tailored the body just a touch for a more elevated silhouette. Details include the button placket, chest pockets, hip pockets, button cuffs, and a curved hem.

title: UltimateS Meko Nightie - Fine Stripe in Navy/White
sourceText: We made your cute and comfy nightie in our light-as-air UltimateS fabric. This mini sleep dress features a perfectly placed v-neck and cut-out on the leg that's both understated and sexy.

title: The Refined Lou High Rise Barrel Leg Jeans - Union City Blue
sourceText: These are the jeans you need right now. High-waisted with a roomy barrel leg. It took five rounds of fittings to perfect this of-the-moment silhouette. With just enough volume that tapers at the ankle, they're made from a structured (but still stretchy) denim that holds its shape. We designed these to be styled two ways—play with sizing to find your favorite fit. Choose your true size if you’re into the oversize look, and size down if you want these jeans to feel fitted through the hips.
